Are you sure your private information is still private? Private conversations, financial information and unshared plans can become leverage over your money, reputation and decisions. Exposure includes what someone can reach, copies already held elsewhere and what separate details reveal together. Dr. Lior Tabansky works with you in person to assess exposure and carry out agreed protection for your devices and accounts. Contact may be visible on your device or account. Before you get in touch The conversation, assessment and protection. The first private conversation is free. The paid assessment and protection are separate decisions. Private Exposure Assessment: ₪4,000. Half a day in person to establish your personal threat model, assess exposure and set priorities. You keep the written exposure summary whether or not you continue. Personal Shield: ₪32,000. Separately agreed protection for one person, covering up to three everyday devices, relevant accounts and one home network within the agreed scope. Other household tiers are available.
